lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: # cigster-99: Multi-browser living-room E2E + rename visual→e2e

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: PR #99, implements ticket #98. No review comments. The PR is mixed: one ticket story plus several unrelated harness changes.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Why: either. If present, it covers only the living-room part, from #98. The other parts have no source motive.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Size: very-large. `pnpm-lock.yaml` and the 135 pure moves add little burden, but the rest is still large.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Parts: 3 to 7. A harness part can hold the rename, the snapshot folders, and the local Convex startup. Groups: 7 to 10.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. Living-room E2E (#98): `e2e/live/living-room.spec.ts`, `e2e/seed/living-room.ts`, `e2e/pages/living-room.ts`, the living-room hunk in `e2e/seed/reset.ts`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 2. Page objects: `e2e/pages/*` except `living-room.ts`, and the visual specs rewritten on top of them. Two groups are fine: the page-object modules, then the migrated specs.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. Rename visual→e2e: `.github/workflows/e2e.yml`, `compose.yaml`, `e2e/docker/*` scripts, `.cursor/CLOUD.md`, `e2e/README.md`, `docs/css-modules-migration-plan.md`, `e2e/auth/global.setup.ts`, `e2e/visual/_helpers.ts`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. Local Convex and webServer startup: `e2e/docker/server.sh`, `e2e/seed/_run.ts`, `e2e/seed/_clerk-auth.ts`, the env loading and `reuseExistingServer` hunks in `e2e/playwright.config.ts`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 5. Platform snapshot folders (mechanical): the 135 pure moves to `e2e/snapshots/linux/`, `snapshotPathTemplate`, `.gitignore`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 6. QR readiness fix: `src/lib/shared/useQRCodeSVG.ts`, the QR waits in the page objects, and the three PNGs that are new images, not moves (`tv-lobby-landscape`, `tv-break-landscape`, `remote-break-portrait`).

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 7. Dependency refresh (mechanical): `package.json` pins become caret ranges, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `.nvmrc`, the Playwright pin in `e2e/docker/Dockerfile`, the regenerated `src/routeTree.gen.ts`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 8. Page-object audit report: `docs/audits/e2e-pageobject-audit.html`. Independent documentation, last.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: `package.json` has one hunk that holds both the script rename and the dependency refresh. The group that holds it names both.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Must state

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `useQRCodeSVG` is production code in a test PR. Its effect now depends on the primitive option values, so a new `options` object on each render no longer makes a new QR code. It also passes only width, margin, and colors to the library.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The PR says `pnpm test:e2e:ui` sets `E2E_UI=1` and skips the webServer. At head nothing reads `E2E_UI`, and the webServer still starts unless `E2E_HARNESS_ONLY=1`. If you follow the PR note and start `pnpm dev` first, Playwright fails because port 3000 is in use. `reuseExistingServer` is on only with `E2E_REUSE_SERVER=1`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `e2e/docker/server.sh` deletes `.env.local` when it starts and when it exits. Any local settings in that file are lost when you run the e2e suite.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - After the TV closes, the host leaves the Remote shell only when something writes to the game. The spec waits 12.5 seconds and then sends a `pause` playback command to force that write. In the app, the shell stays until the next game write, for example the next host action. The ticket asks that sleeps and races be called out in the PR, and the PR body does not do that.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Good to state

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Three goldens are new images, not moves.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - All dependency pins become caret ranges. That is a policy change in a PR about tests.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The seed variables keep the `VISUAL_` prefix (`VISUAL_SEED_SUBJECT` and others) after the rename.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not repeat the `E2E_UI` note as what the code does.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not chain the living-room part to the page-objects or harness parts with `dependsOn`. The living-room spec does build on the page objects, so `suggestedOrder` puts the page-object library before it.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not fold the dependency refresh into a group titled as a rename without naming it.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not restate ticket acceptance items that the spec meets.
